# Urban Crescent

> Urban Crescent is an interior design and execution studio in India. We design, manufacture and install complete home interiors end to end — from the first consultation to handover — and customise product brands (plywood, laminates, hardware, fittings) to each customer's choice.

Cities: Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune.
Contact: +91 96201 81911 (phone and WhatsApp)
Address: OMBR Layout, Kasturi Nagar, Bangalore 560043
Website: https://www.urbancrescentdesign.com

## Services

- Modular Kitchens: precision-built kitchen systems, cabinets, countertops and finishes.
- Modular Wardrobes: walk-in and wall-to-wall storage.
- Living Spaces: living rooms and open-plan zones.
- Bedroom Sanctuaries: bedrooms with headboards, study nooks and ambient lighting.
- Lighting Design: ambient, task and accent lighting planned per room.
- Painting & Finishes: colour consultation, textures and premium paints.

## How we work

1. Discovery: free consultation to understand the customer's space and lifestyle.
2. Site visit: measurement of the space and its site conditions.
3. Design: 3D concepts and material boards by senior designers.
4. Manufacture: factory-built modular units with quality checks.
5. Install: delivery and installation by our own crew.
6. Handover: a full walkthrough and snag resolution.

## Warranty

- Plywood: up to 7 years against manufacturing defects, depending on grade and brand.
- Hardware: 1 year on functional components, as per brand policy.
Terms depend on the selected products, approved specifications and project conditions.

## Booking

Customers book a free consultation through the form at https://www.urbancrescentdesign.com/#contact, which opens WhatsApp (+91 96201 81911) with their details (name, phone, email, property location and service of interest), or by phone or WhatsApp.
